description: Type the 409 `route-taken` that a write adding routes gets when another app holds one of them. The spec documents it on PUT /v1/apps/{project} (putApp: "A route another app holds is 409 `route-taken`"), on PATCH /v1/apps/{project}/routes (patchRoutes: the same sentence) and on POST /v1/apps/{project}/builds (createBuild: "Route ownership and conflicts are checked up front"); Sproutboat's provider guide lists it under 409 ("`route-taken` (another app holds the route)", https://sproutboat.com/docs/api/build-a-provider#errors-and-retries). It generated as the generic Conflict.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Another app of the team (or of another team) already holds one of the routes. Remove it there first, or pick another route.
